card.name: Words leading into 'your' or directives
card.fires_on: Words in instructions that address the reader or lead into 'your' or a direct command, such as 'your' after 'keeping' or 'call', 'with' after 'Discuss', and a sentence-opening 'Do' in 'Do not'.

modes.label: The phrase 'Discuss with'
modes.description: The word 'with' right after 'Discuss' in advice to prescribers, before 'your patient' or 'patients'.
modes.example: Discuss<< with>> your patient the benefits and risks of estrogen

modes.label: The word 'your' after a verb
modes.description: The word 'your' following an instruction verb, addressing the reader.
modes.example: If over-exposure of dronabinol oral solution occurs, call<< your>> Poison Control Center at 1-8

modes.label: The phrase 'Do not'
modes.description: The word 'Do' starting a prohibition in label instructions.
modes.example: (36°F to 46°F).<< Do>> not freeze. The reconstituted
